sampleObservations.observation: Both formats show a clean dark midnight-blue field at the opening and final samples, without residual glyphs, titles or rectangular edges.
Both lyric regions are clear. The source figure and flame remain integrated into the blue field; the portrait source image fades smoothly into the lower lyric area.
Both formats show the I + always group in pale gold while But and the remaining words stay silver. Word spacing and baseline look natural, with no active-word underline, box or pill.
Able is emphasized in pale gold in both formats. The line remains legible and comfortably within the lyric region.
Silver receives the gold emphasis in both formats. Landscape and portrait use clean, different line breaks without clipping or collisions.
Before retains pale-gold focus in the final lyric line in both formats. The line is fully readable, and no closing title overlaps it.
The lyric region is clear and the muted-gold italic closing title appears in both formats. Its decorative rule is separate from the removed lyric-word underlines.

overallObservations: The active pale-gold and inactive silver words have clear visual contrast against the midnight-blue background, with consistent size and weight in the sampled lyric states.
Color-only emphasis provides a restrained cinematic treatment. No karaoke word underlines, word boxes, pills or displaced glyphs are visible in these samples.
No obvious rectangular shade patch, source-crop edge or background seam is visible at the displayed review scale. The figure, flame, header and spectrum retain a coherent visual style.
Closing-title separation and the final clear frame are visually correct in the inspected samples.
limits: This review inspected rendered full-frame PNG proofs, not frames decoded from the final encoded videos.
The images were displayed at the reduced sizes recorded above; this is not a native-pixel seam or compression-artifact inspection.
Nonconsecutive stills cannot establish temporal word-position stability, animation smoothness or correctness at every frame.
No acoustic listening was performed for this review, and no claim of acoustic synchronization or held-vocal endpoint accuracy follows from these stills.
The separate viewport-proof.json records sampled pixel equality. This visual review does not extend that proof to every frame, retained outside pixels or the final encodes.
